role: retrospective SEEN post-confirmation analysis; not fresh external confirmation
public_rule: Existing registered SameContextSupport: same-context eligible historical experiments if any, otherwise all eligible histories; weights proportional to cell support
effect_estimand: Cell-weighted treated-minus-control effect; common2840; no missing-gene zero-fill
public_quality: True quality measurements distinct from cell support; no invented replicate quality
feedback_split: Reuse exact immutable SafeConf-McFaline-feedback-v1 biological-gene partition, budget order and evaluation IDs
unaffected_methods: Reuse exact matched TargetOnly Ridge/HGB and PertEMA_P_adapted predictions, with input/output SHA and task alignment checks
shared_control: Existing frozen legacy Shared score retained and labeled with its guide-public lineage; cannot certify new Public configuration
feedback_CDF: Only each permitted feedback budget errors; no additional target validation errors for risk labels/calibration/model choice
upstream_calibration: Original C upstream validation calibration retained and counted, not portrayed as no C validation information
statistics: 5000 paired biological-gene bootstrap; identical task IDs and cluster draws across methods; three seed metrics averaged
holdout_selection: No result-dependent algorithm/feature/threshold selection; all budget predictions saved before evaluation
